shortDescription: Mexican builder Consorcio ARA BMV:ARA said on Tuesday that two of its largest shareholders plan to launch a tender offer for all outstanding shares in the firm.ARA said in a filing that German Ahumada, a founding partner and honorary chairman of the firm, and his brother Luis Felipe, vice chairman…

children: said on Tuesday that two of its largest shareholders plan to launch a tender offer for all outstanding shares in the firm.

ARA said in a filing that German Ahumada, a founding partner and honorary chairman of the firm, and his brother Luis Felipe, vice chairman and head of the shopping-center division, offered 5.63 pesos ($0.3116) per share, or a 20% premium.
The bidders do not plan to take the firm private, ARA added.
The bid comes two weeks after a similar offer for logistics and transportation company Traxion linked to its co-founder.
At the end of last year, the brothers held a combined 54% stake in ARA.
ARA is one of Mexico's top homebuilders, and has reported selling more than 405,500 homes. It also operates a portfolio of neighborhood and regional shopping centers tied to its housing developments.
